chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Wahb ibn Hafs from Abu Baseer from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman who died and left her husband, he said: The wealth is for the husband, meaning when there is no other inheritor for her besides him.
ai.seo_question: Who inherits a woman's entire estate if she has no other heirs besides her husband?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific scenario of 'furda' where the husband inherits the entire estate in the absence of children, parents, or siblings. This ruling highlights the husband's unique position as the sole residual heir when no other primary or secondary relatives exist, a principle deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence.
